_comment: Identity-harness fixture (phased architecture S1). Hand-built to exercise EVERY branch of the evidence assembly: speech + caption transcript sources, all three 6-3-3 temporal buckets, populated engagement signals (so the engagement + temporal blocks render), music signals, remix metadata, decoded symbols in all four categories, and a non-empty location. Shapes mirror the real types in webResearch.ts / symbolDecoder.ts. Content is synthetic; a companion fixture captured from a real run lives alongside this one.

capture.bio: toronto street interviews · asking strangers the hard questions

transcripts.caption: asking torontonians what they'd change about the city #streetinterview #toronto
transcripts.transcript: If you could change one thing about Toronto what would it be? Honestly the rent. Rent for sure. I'd say transit, the TTC is unreliable after ten. Everyone says rent but nobody says why. Because nobody can afford to stay where they grew up.

transcripts.caption: would you take the money or the mystery box? #hypothetical
transcripts.transcript: Ten thousand dollars right now, or this box that might have a hundred thousand. Box. Box every time. See that's the thing, nobody takes the sure money anymore. Everyone thinks they're due for a win.

transcripts.caption: the dating question nobody answers honestly #opinion
transcripts.transcript: Would you date someone who makes less than you? Depends how much less. That's not a no. It's not a yes either.

transcripts.caption: kingston road at 2am #streetinterview #kingstreet
transcripts.transcript: What are you doing out here at two in the morning? Waiting for my friend who is definitely not coming. That's the most Toronto answer I've heard all night.

transcripts.caption: asking people what they actually earn #money
transcripts.transcript: How much do you make? That's so rude. It is rude. Are you going to answer? Ninety a year. And you? Not ninety a year.
